purpose: base-model selection for airobloxbuilder specialist fine-tuning
selection_notes: These are starting checkpoints, not trained airobloxbuilder models.
Prefer QLoRA/LoRA adapters so the base model stays untouched.
The factory requires a CUDA-capable runner for actual training.
Model licenses must be reviewed before redistribution.

code.reason: Current small Qwen3.5 checkpoint with strong coding/agent potential and Apache-2.0 licensing.

design.reason: Compact multimodal Gemma 4 checkpoint suited to spatial, visual and agent-oriented design tasks.

animation.reason: Compact multimodal checkpoint for animation specifications, timing, asset manifests and content-planning outputs.

testing.reason: Compact current Qwen checkpoint that can be specialized around test generation, failure diagnosis and repair trajectories.
